description: This file contains the definition of the ArrayExpression class in the Twig templating engine, responsible for representing and compiling array expressions within Twig templates.

classes.name: ArrayExpression
classes.description: Represents an array expression node within Twig's abstract syntax tree, capable of managing key-value pairs, checking for elements, adding elements, and compiling the array into executable PHP code.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes an ArrayExpression instance with elements and line number, and determines the highest numerical key index.

methods.name: getKeyValuePairs
methods.description: Returns an array of key-value pairs extracted from the node's children.

methods.name: hasElement
methods.description: Checks whether a given key element exists within the array expression.

methods.name: addElement
methods.description: Adds a new value to the array, optionally with a specific key.

methods.name: compile
methods.description: Converts the array expression node into PHP code using the provided compiler, handling spread operators and key-value formatting.
